name: Warehouse-wise Pick List report
query:
SELECT 
    pl.name AS "Pick List",
    pi.warehouse AS "Warehouse",
    pi.item_code AS "Item",
    pi.qty AS "Quantity",
    pl.status AS "Status"
FROM 
    `tabPick List Item` pi
JOIN 
    `tabPick List` pl ON pi.parent = pl.name
WHERE 
    pl.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY 
    pi.warehouse, pl.name;
